notes.text: לו:. gives Bekhorot 36b with terminal stop, and כ. gives Chagigah 20a under the colon/period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Bar and ben remain distinct source forms, and the two attestations do not establish a single father. The bare heading gains no title; both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
